Metadata.title: Elmanian hypnosis training in Switzerland | mhp-coaching
Metadata.description: Hypnosis training in Fribourg: the OMNI® curriculum, advanced study, medical hypnosis and practical workshops.

HomePage.title: Elmanian hypnosis training, taught with calm precision.
HomePage.intro: mhp-coaching offers contemporary, direct, solution-focused hypnosis in Fribourg — taught with precision in a professional setting.
HomePage.aboutTitle: A school for people who will actually practise.
HomePage.aboutBody: Founded by Marta Hegyaljai Python, mhp-coaching brings the OMNI method into French and German-speaking practice. Groups stay small. Teaching stays practical. Recognition (ASCA, NGH, APSH, eduQua) supports a serious professional path — without turning the website into a diploma factory.
HomePage.coursesIntro: Start with the OMNI® curriculum, then deepen your practice through advanced modules and medical hypnosis. Upcoming dates are shown on each course.
HomePage.whyRapidBody: Inductions are designed to reach a useful depth quickly, with tests you can actually use in the room.
HomePage.whyPracticeBody: Groups are limited to sixteen people, with an instructor and assistants, so practice is supervised rather than theoretical.
HomePage.whyNetworkBody: OMNI has taught Elmanian hypnosis since 1979. The practitioner training is the door into that community and its certifications.
HomePage.coursesMore: You are seeing {shown} of {count}: the catalogue also covers advanced modules, medical hypnosis and practical workshops.

Admin.title: Users
Admin.intro: Invite people, change their access, and disable or re-enable accounts. Therapists cannot register themselves.
Admin.identityNote: Email uniquely identifies each account. Two users cannot share the same address.
Admin.emailHint: This address identifies the account and must be unique.
Admin.listIntro: Search the directory, then open Manage to change access or disable an account.
Admin.name: Name
Admin.accessHelp: Administrators manage users and staff lists. Room booking lets a therapist use the rooms module.
Admin.disableHelp: A disabled account cannot sign in. You can re-enable it later. The email stays reserved for this user.
Admin.enableHelp: Re-enable this account so they can sign in again.
Admin.adminBookingsIntro: Create, move or cancel a booking for a therapist, and waive a late charge. History is append-only.
Admin.createBookingTitle: Create a booking for a user
Admin.createBookingIntro: The user must have room booking enabled. Availability rules still apply.
Admin.noAdminBookings: No room bookings match this filter.
Admin.adminCreated: The booking was created and the user was notified.
Admin.adminMoved: The booking was moved and the user was notified.
Admin.emptyRoomUsers: No enabled users currently have room booking access.
Admin.adminRequestsIntro: Requests do not reserve a room. Resolve or decline them without rearranging bookings automatically.
Admin.adminRequestNoteHelp: Visible only to administrators. The therapist cannot read this.
Admin.billingIntro: Open-month totals across therapists. This is not a finalized statement. A discount change applies only to bookings created afterwards.
Admin.billingEmpty: No room usage in the open month matches this filter.
Admin.billingClosedIntro: Usage for a finished Zurich month. Finalize per therapist to lock a statement. Later price or discount changes do not rewrite a finalized statement.
Admin.finalizeHelp: Lock booking-derived line items for this closed month. The total equals the lines. This does not charge the card.
Admin.cannotFinalizeOpen: The open month cannot be finalized yet. Totals can still change.
Admin.alreadyFinalizedHelp: This month is already finalized. Booking-derived lines stay immutable; use an adjustment for a correction.
Admin.finalizeNoMethod: No saved payment method. You can still finalize a zero or non-zero statement; charging comes later.
Admin.finalizeZeroTotal: This statement totals zero. Finalizing is allowed and will not require a card.
Admin.adjustmentHelp: Add a reasoned credit or debit. Original booking lines stay unchanged. Amounts are CHF, negative for a credit.
Admin.adjustmentAmountHelp: Use a minus sign for a credit, for example -25.00.
Admin.adjustmentReasonHelp: Visible on the statement. Do not include patient information.
Admin.paymentMethodMissingHelp: The therapist has not saved a payment method yet.
Admin.billingUserEmpty: This user has no room bookings in the open month.
Admin.discountHelp: One percentage off the room hourly rate, applied to every new booking for this person. Existing snapshots stay unchanged.
Admin.discountPercentHelp: Whole number from 0 to {max}. Applied after the room price, only to bookings created after you save.
Admin.discountUpdated: Discount updated. Existing bookings are unchanged.
Admin.noBookingActions: This booking can no longer be changed.
Admin.waiveHelp: Waiving removes the late charge of {amount} from the monthly statement. The cancellation itself stays in the history.

Rooms.title: Rooms
Rooms.intro: Choose an available date and start time. The calendar automatically finds a free room; you then review the duration and price before confirming.
Rooms.emptyInventory: No rooms are available yet. An administrator needs to configure inventory.
Rooms.filteredRoomMissing: That filter no longer matches a room.
Rooms.filterRoomsHelp: Select only the rooms you would accept, then apply the filter. Leave every room unchecked to consider all rooms.
Rooms.selectedRoomsHint: {count, plural, one {# room selected} other {# rooms selected}}
Rooms.selectedRoomsTitle: {count, plural, one {# selected room} other {# selected rooms}}
Rooms.bookingGuideConfirm: Review the room, end and price
Rooms.calendarAvailabilityHelp: All rooms are grouped by default. When you filter, the availability count includes only your selected rooms. Every Available row is a clickable start time. Past room use can also be added later.
Rooms.bookAtTime: Book at {time} — {count, plural, one {# room available} other {# rooms available}}
Rooms.requestsIntro: Ask for a time when no room is free. A request does not reserve a room. The message is visible to administrators; keep patient information out of it.
Rooms.requestsEmpty: You have not requested an unavailable time yet.

Rooms.requestDoesNotReserve: A request does not reserve the slot.
Rooms.requestMessageHelp: Optional. Visible to administrators only. Do not include patient information.
Rooms.requestPatientWarning: Do not include patient names or clinical details in this message.

Rooms.privateNoteWarning: Personal reminder only. Do not store medical records or detailed clinical information here.
Rooms.submitted: The request was sent. The slot is still unreserved.

Rooms.chooseAvailableRoomHelp: {count, plural, one {# room is available for this start time.} other {# rooms are available for this start time.}}
Rooms.bookBilling: No payment is taken now. This amount is added to your monthly room statement.
Rooms.bookingsIntro: Upcoming reservations and history. Amounts are calculated when you book and do not change if the room rate later changes.
Rooms.bookingsEmpty: You have not reserved a room yet.
Rooms.usageIntro: Minutes and estimated amount for the open Zurich month. This is not a finalized statement and can still change.
Rooms.usageOpenHelp: Totals follow completed use, late charges and waivers. Free cancellations appear at zero. Historical statements are issued after month close.

Rooms.usageClosedHelp: This Zurich month has ended. Totals stay estimates until an administrator finalizes a statement.
Rooms.paymentMethodHelp: Monthly room statements are charged to this saved card. MHP stores only the brand, last four digits and expiry — never the full card number.
Rooms.paymentMethodMissingHelp: Add a card before month close so a non-zero statement can be charged later.
Rooms.paymentMethodSafeNote: Full card numbers never touch this application.
Rooms.paymentMethodReturnFailed: The card could not be saved. Return to billing and try again.
Rooms.fakeSetupIntro: Local and preview environments use a fake Visa ending 4242. Nothing is sent to Stripe.
Rooms.statementsHelp: Finalized monthly statements stay unchanged if prices or discounts later move. Corrections appear only as explicit adjustments.
Rooms.statementsEmpty: No finalized statements yet. The open month is shown above until an administrator closes it.
Rooms.statementLinesEmpty: This statement has no line items.
Rooms.changeIntro: Choose another available room or time. The original booking rules still apply.
Rooms.changeLateWarning: This change is inside the cancellation notice. Confirming it cancels the current time with a late charge of {amount} and reserves the new time.
Rooms.replaced: The previous time was cancelled with a late charge. The new time is reserved.
Rooms.cancelIntro: Cancelling releases the room immediately. The booking is kept in your history.
Rooms.cancelFreeHelp: This cancellation is outside the notice window. There is no charge.
Rooms.cancelLateHelp: This cancellation is inside the notice window. Confirming it keeps a late charge of {amount}.
Rooms.billingUsage: Added to the monthly room statement.
Rooms.noValidEnds: This start time cannot be reserved. Choose another available slot.
Rooms.adminRoomsIntro: Create rooms, set the hourly rate, disable them, and add temporary blocks. Opening hours live in Settings.
Rooms.name: Name
Rooms.hourlyRateHelp: Stored as integer centimes. Therapists see this rate before they book.
Rooms.availabilityHelp: A disabled room disappears from the therapist calendar.
Rooms.blocksIntro: Times are Europe/Zurich wall-clock. A block that overlaps a confirmed reservation is rejected and does not cancel it.
Rooms.settingsIntro: Weekly opening hours, booking intervals and notice rules. Europe/Zurich is the authoritative timezone.
Rooms.hoursHelp: Closed days have no bookable time. Open intervals must align with the booking interval.
Rooms.advanceHelp: Leave empty for no advance limit.
Rooms.releaseNote: The room is released immediately and can be booked by someone else.
